svg.title: 55b Setup: New account code
svg.text: Budget lines use an account code; each maps to Finance's chart of accounts for the export.

g.text: Codes are illustrative. During inception they are copied from IDIU's accounting package so every commitment and payment exports to the right ledger account.

svg.text: Budget lines use it; the export maps it to the accounting package.

g.text: Once a budget line uses it, it can be deactivated, never deleted.
